component.name: Link Studio
component.summary: Native Linux controller for Insta360 Link webcams

description.p: Link Studio provides live preview and capture, safe hardware camera controls, local AI effects and tracking, audio processing modes, scenes, a teleprompter, phone and global remote control, and automatic Omarchy theming for Insta360 Link webcams.
First production release, hardware-tested with Insta360 Link 2 on Omarchy.
